description: This PHP source file defines the class Admin_UI_ChannelIdField, which extends Admin_UI_Field. It provides methods to display a dropdown of channels and retrieve channels based on user permissions and filters, specifically for the admin interface of the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: Admin_UI_ChannelIdField
classes.description: A class for rendering a channel selection dropdown and fetching channels based on user permissions and filters.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs HTML for a select dropdown of channels.

methods.name: getChannels
methods.description: Retrieves a list of channels filtered by user permissions, publisher, and agency filters.

methods.name: displayChannelsAsOptionList
methods.description: Outputs HTML option tags for each channel in the list.
